entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling because I need to return a helmet I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF886753.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered on November 8th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. The color wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, I just never got around to sending it back.
I see. So no concerns with the safety features or anything like that, just the color wasn't a match. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've confirmed everything. Since it was delivered 65 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I've just approved the return for you. You'll receive an email with a return label and instructions within the next 15 minutes.

That's great news, thank you, Charlie. I appreciate that. Since I am going through the trouble of returning this and plan to buy another one, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? I still want a VeloFit helmet because your brand has the best reputation for safety.

We're happy you're sticking with us for your safety needs. I'm afraid my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns, but I can assure you the full refund for this helmet will be processed as soon as we receive the item. The return instructions are on their way to your email now.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. Thanks for your help today.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
